patient_characteristic_or_signal: Waist circumference, WHtR, BMI, body weight; FLI_proxy/HSI_partial
why_it_is_relevant: These were influential model features or engineered features in SHAP. SHAP importance describes model behaviour, not causation or diagnosis.
candidate_nutritional_objective: Support appropriate energy intake and evidence-informed weight management, where clinically appropriate.
evidence_basis: Weight-loss intervention evidence (including Vilar-Gomez et al., 2015) and dietary-intervention reviews; effects are intervention-level, not recipe-level.
recipe_fields_that_may_later_help: Calories per serving; serving information; overall nutritional profile
status_for_october_9: Candidate mapping; no patient-specific assignment or score yet
guardrail: Do not infer a specific calorie target from BMI, waist, or predicted CAP. No clinical threshold is defined here.

patient_characteristic_or_signal: Diet quality / recipe composition (not directly inferred from SHAP)
why_it_is_relevant: The evidence table includes recommendations for an overall Mediterranean-style dietary pattern and improved diet quality.
candidate_nutritional_objective: Consider recipe characteristics consistent with an overall high-quality dietary pattern when supported by the evidence layer.
evidence_basis: 2024 EASL-EASD-EASO MASLD guideline; Mediterranean-diet reviews/meta-analyses in the evidence table.
recipe_fields_that_may_later_help: Total fat, saturated fat, fiber, sugar, protein, carbohydrates; ingredient list
guardrail: A single recipe cannot be claimed to reproduce the clinical effect of a whole dietary pattern.

patient_characteristic_or_signal: High saturated-fat or sugar content in a recipe (recipe-side feature, not a patient characteristic)
why_it_is_relevant: The guideline recommends limiting ultra-processed foods rich in sugars and saturated fat and avoiding sugar-sweetened beverages.
candidate_nutritional_objective: Identify recipe characteristics relevant to limiting saturated fat and sugar, where appropriate.
evidence_basis: 2024 EASL-EASD-EASO MASLD guideline; guideline recommendations remain distinct from intervention-trial strength labels.
guardrail: No numeric cutoff or penalty is assigned in this task; do not label a recipe clinically harmful from one field alone.

why_it_is_relevant: These features contributed to CAP predictions, but SHAP does not establish an individual need for a glucose-targeted diet.
candidate_nutritional_objective: Keep glucose-related nutrition as a possible objective requiring an explicit evidence link and appropriate patient context.
evidence_basis: The current evidence table does not establish a patient-specific glucose objective solely from SHAP results.
guardrail: Do not assign a glucose-management objective based only on feature importance.

why_it_is_relevant: These are model features or engineered ratios, but SHAP importance alone is not a treatment recommendation.
candidate_nutritional_objective: Keep lipid-related nutrition as a candidate objective only if supported by an explicit intervention-outcome evidence row and patient context.
evidence_basis: Current evidence includes broader dietary-pattern evidence but does not itself justify a patient-specific lipid target.
recipe_fields_that_may_later_help: Total fat, saturated fat, fiber; ingredient list
status_for_october_9: Unresolved; needs more specific evidence mapping
guardrail: Do not derive a recipe penalty or individual treatment from TG_HDL or other predictors alone.

patient_characteristic_or_signal: Liver enzymes (e.g., AST/ALT, GGT) and predicted CAP
why_it_is_relevant: Liver-related outcomes appear in the evidence table; predicted CAP is a model output, not a full clinical assessment.
candidate_nutritional_objective: Use liver-health evidence to define broad dietary objectives, while keeping predicted CAP separate from clinical diagnosis and treatment.
evidence_basis: Mediterranean-diet and dietary-intervention reviews report effects on some liver outcomes, with outcome-specific mixed findings.
recipe_fields_that_may_later_help: Overall nutritional profile and ingredients, after an explicit objective-to-feature rule is defined
status_for_october_9: Evidence link identified; recipe mapping remains preliminary
guardrail: Do not promise that a recipe will lower CAP, AST, ALT, or GGT; study-level effects cannot be assigned directly to a recipe.

patient_characteristic_or_signal: Age, sex, race/ethnicity and other influential predictors

candidate_nutritional_objective: No direct nutritional objective assigned from SHAP alone.
evidence_basis: The current evidence table does not establish a direct objective from these model features alone.
recipe_fields_that_may_later_help: None until an independently justified objective is defined
guardrail: Avoid turning demographic associations into dietary rules or stereotypes.
